title: Standard F1B Goldendoodles
temperament: Standard F1B Goldendoodles are high-energy, intelligent, and incredibly social companions. Combining the gentle nature of the Golden Retriever with the advanced trainability of the Poodle, they are the ultimate family dog.
cardDesc: Standard F1B Goldendoodles — highly intelligent and social family companions. The ultimate "velcro dog" that is eager to please. Willow x Bonsai litter
